# Let me verify the player position first
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
blue = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
def center(n):
    b = n['boundary']
    return (sum(p[0] for p in b)/len(b), sum(p[1] for p in b)/len(b))
print(f"Player at: {center(blue)}")

# Execute the path
path = ['UP', 'UP', 'LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT', 'DOWN', 'DOWN', 'RIGHT']
result = action(path, intent='solve')
print(f"\nLevel completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
print(f"Done: {last_action_result.get('done')}")

# Check final position
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
nodes2 = seg2['nodes']
blue2 = [n for n in nodes2 if n['color'] == 'b']
if blue2:
    print(f"Player now at: {center(blue2[0])}")
else:
    print("Player not found (maybe merged with goal?)")
</parameter>
</function>
